role: external extension of an element of an L_in-structure
notes: The ambient set of b in the domain with M satisfying b in a; a subset of the domain. Shares the operator name ext with the P2 extensional-collapse map and the P10 semilattice extension, in different scopes and roles.

role: interpretation of the membership symbol in a structure
notes: Instance of the general interpretation superscript R^{M}; need not be the ambient membership relation.

role: named L_in-formula abbreviation: e is empty
notes: Object-language abbreviations eliminating the empty set, S(x), omega and power set of sec:zf-zfc-01 into membership formulas.

role: named L_in-formula abbreviation: y is the successor of x
notes: Object-language abbreviations eliminating the empty set, S(x), omega and power set of sec:zf-zfc-01 into membership formulas.

role: named L_in-formula abbreviation: v is inductive
notes: Object-language abbreviations eliminating the empty set, S(x), omega and power set of sec:zf-zfc-01 into membership formulas.

role: named L_in-formula abbreviation: w is the least inductive set
notes: Object-language abbreviations eliminating the empty set, S(x), omega and power set of sec:zf-zfc-01 into membership formulas.

role: named L_in-formula abbreviation: p is the power set of w
notes: Object-language abbreviations eliminating the empty set, S(x), omega and power set of sec:zf-zfc-01 into membership formulas.

role: named L_in-formula abbreviation for a Kuratowski pair
notes: OP(z,u,v) says z is the Kuratowski pair of u and v; In(u,v,g) says that pair belongs to g.

role: named L_in-formula abbreviation for pair membership
notes: OP(z,u,v) says z is the Kuratowski pair of u and v; In(u,v,g) says that pair belongs to g.

role: named L_in-formula: g injects a into w
notes: Ctbl(a) is the internal reading of the countability definition of sec:set-prerequisites-05 (injection into omega).

role: named L_in-formula: a is internally countable
notes: Ctbl(a) is the internal reading of the countability definition of sec:set-prerequisites-05 (injection into omega).

role: L_in-sentence asserting that the power set of omega is not injectable into omega
notes: Proved from extensionality; power set; separation and infinity in thm:p02-w02-p02-033-cantor-internal.

role: the unique element of a model satisfying Om over it
notes: Uniqueness by extensionality inside the model.

role: the unique element of a model satisfying Pw over \(\omega^{\mathcal M}\)
notes: Uniqueness by extensionality inside the model.

role: external relation coded by an element g of an L_in-structure
notes: Set of pairs (b,c) with M satisfying In(b,c,g); R is also a generic relation-symbol metavariable elsewhere.

role: binary code of a finite 0-1 sequence
notes: 2 to the length plus the binary value; same operator name as other code maps registered in other scopes.

role: set of new elements of the target outside the image of an elementary embedding
notes: Local names in the isomorphic-copy construction.

role: transport isomorphism of the isomorphic copy
notes: Local names in the isomorphic-copy construction.

role: fresh copy of the new-element set
notes: Local names in the isomorphic-copy construction.

role: fresh index making the copy disjoint from the old domain
notes: Local names in the isomorphic-copy construction.

role: numeral map of an L_A-structure
notes: Sends n to the value of the numeral S^n0 in M; its range is the set of standard elements.

role: relation on an L_A-structure defined by the abbreviation r<t
notes: Pairs (b,b') with M satisfying exists z (b+Sz=b'); not a signature symbol of L_A.

role: L_A-sentences describing the elements below and comparable with a numeral
notes: Local sentence names; theta_n and tau_n are registered with unrelated roles in P15 and P6 scopes.

role: compactness theories of the nonstandard-model examples
notes: T_1: true arithmetic with c different from every numeral; T_2: with c nonzero and divisible by every prime; T_3: elementary diagram of the real ordered field with c above every real.

role: finite-satisfiability witness for a finite fragment Delta
notes: The interpretation of the new constant c chosen for Delta; depends on Delta.

role: divisibility abbreviation in L_A
notes: Abbreviates exists z (t times z = u) with z the first variable not in t or u; the glyph is registered for conditional probability and dyadic obligation in other scopes.

role: ordered-field signature and the real ordered field
notes: Signature {0,1,+,cdot,<}; structure (R,0,1,+,cdot,<). The calligraphic R also names the relation-symbol family of a signature globally; the subscript separates them.

role: closed L_of-term for a natural number
notes: underline 0 = 0 and underline(n+1) = (underline n + 1); underline is registered with other roles in P10 and P12 scopes.

role: local sentence names in proofs
notes: Used only inside the annex proofs of the nonstandard-model examples (numeral, infinitesimal and fails items).
